title: WINGA SHOPPING ROOMS — PRODUCTION-GRADE COLLABORATIVE COMMERCE SYSTEM — SPECIFICATION v1.0

input.provenance: User message in this chat; this file is an implementation audit/normalized requirements map, not a verbatim source or reconstructed continuation.

classificationMeaning: IMPLEMENTED means canonical source exists; it is not live acceptance, a security audit or a production-ready claim. FUTURE means explicitly optional/future/possible scope, not mandatory work to invent. Conditional scope must be revisited if selected.

foundationChecks.finding: Canonical direct vs shopping-room identities exist; no duplicate messaging system.
Durable ciphertext routing/store and verified endpoint decrypt exist; real live user flow remains open.
Phoenix routing is integrated; authenticated deployed failure/capacity acceptance remains open.
Encrypted outbox/resume/history source exists; real PWA offline/reload acceptance remains open.
Stable IDs/exact ciphertext, reservations and transition retries exist; fixture proof does not certify all live flows.
Room projection uses canonical sequences; direct/mixed timestamp sorting remains a foundation gap.
Canonical encrypted media and direct voice exist; actual device/media acceptance is open. Room voice/composer integration is a separate downstream Room gap.
Canonical current product references/cards and Room board/comparison exist; real internal sharing acceptance remains open. Room-specific command/card UX is downstream integration.
Native signed account/device membership and UI identity exist; physical trust approval remains open.
Canonical receipts/current viewport visibility guards exist; real multi-device acceptance remains open.
Generic durable room delivery/mute source exists; granular notification policies/provider acceptance remain open.
Canonical direct block/report source exists; real acceptance remains open. Room-specific report authorization and shared-room block policy are separate downstream gaps.
Bounded canonical paging, replay and endpoint history exist; projection/retention bounds need review.
Own-native encrypted history sync/recovery source exists; approvals and physical-device acceptance remain open.

sections.title: IMPLEMENTATION PRECONDITION
sections.finding: Conversations source exists, but production-ready foundation is not accepted. Audit existing Rooms only; new dependent feature implementation waits for applicable foundation acceptance.

sections.title: PRODUCT MISSION
sections.finding: Private decision-space guidance, chat, board, comparison and polls exist. Complete decision workflow and purchase/group-order experience remain open.

sections.title: CORE PRODUCT PRINCIPLE
sections.finding: Versioned encrypted commands produce deterministic persistent board/poll/shortlist projections from committed verified history. This is structured event-sourced state, distinct from free chat. Canonical Products and Orders remain external authorities; no duplicate plaintext product/poll database is required.

sections.title: EXAMPLE EXPERIENCE
sections.finding: Five conceptual tabs and product/poll/shortlist surfaces exist. Product reactions/discussion, live rich chat cards and complete decision UX are not equivalent to the illustrated example.

sections.title: ROOM TYPES
sections.finding: One generic canonical room architecture exists. Optional template configuration and roomType UX metadata are absent; WEDDING/BABY/etc. must never become separate backends.

sections.title: ROOM CREATION
sections.finding: Rooms list creation and sharing into existing rooms exist. Product/Collection/Reel/Short share-to-create entry and exact-retry initial structured product attachment are absent. Initial creation currently requires three accounts and device approval; this differs from creating a personal room before inviting friends.

sections.title: ROOM MODEL
sections.finding: Canonical encrypted conversation plus encrypted_shopping_rooms identity/name/revision/createdAt exists. Templates, explicit owner lifecycle/status and update metadata are not the full proposed conceptual model; per-account archive is not room closure.

sections.title: MEMBERSHIP
sections.finding: Signed account roles admin/member, native admission, immutable epoch membership, admin transfer and voluntary leave exist. Conceptual OWNER maps to existing admin authority; do not add a second membership/social graph.

sections.title: INVITATIONS
sections.finding: Canonical native admission and shared Growth invitations have expiry, revocation, quotas, blocks and selected-public-product preview. Link creation is admin-only, which is an explicit current permission boundary.

sections.title: NON-USER INVITATION / ACQUISITION LOOP
sections.finding: Guest scoped product preview, auth return, join request and invite/participation attribution source exist. A request is not canonical membership or activation; real room participation/continuation acceptance is open.

sections.title: PRIVACY
sections.finding: Sharing a seller product does not grant room membership. Ask Seller bridges selected question/product through encrypted direct chat with consent, without room history/roster/title disclosure.

sections.title: ROOM NAVIGATION
sections.finding: CHAT/PRODUCTS/POLLS/SHORTLIST/ORDERS tabs exist. The Orders surface contains authorized canonical references, not collective purchasing.

sections.title: CHAT
sections.finding: Canonical encrypted room messages/files, typed room commands and shared product/Reel/Short/Collection reference cards exist. Room composer does not expose the complete direct voice/reply/reaction/translation workflows.

sections.title: SOCIAL BEHAVIOR MUST REMAIN NATURAL
sections.finding: Text/files and rich discovery references support natural conversation. Voice recording/playback, reactions and replies still need shared canonical composer integration.

sections.title: PERSISTENT PRODUCT BOARD
sections.finding: Committed verified product-share commands project to the persistent Products surface independently of chronological scrolling. Optimistic/pending sends never count as committed products.

sections.title: ROOM PRODUCT MODEL
sections.finding: Product share records preserve canonical productId, sender, logical message/share ID, sequence, optional historical snapshot and removal state. Existing encrypted projections are canonical; no duplicate plaintext product table is needed.

sections.title: LIVE PRODUCT STATE
sections.finding: Products hydrate current authorized catalog price/availability/stock, and missing products remain unavailable. This is view refresh, not a proven realtime room subscription for price/low-stock/restock transitions.

sections.title: PRODUCT SNAPSHOT VS CURRENT STATE
sections.finding: Codec supports an explicitly historical lightweight snapshot and keeps catalog truth separate. Current product-share UI/internal share sends snapshot:null, so added-at-price capture and price-drop event truth are not complete.

sections.title: PRODUCT INTERACTIONS
sections.finding: View/shortlist/compare/Ask Seller/remove exist. Product-scoped social reactions/discussion, product-linked polls, buy/reserve integration and complete context-aware actions remain open.

sections.title: SHORTLIST
sections.finding: Per-account shortlist selection is persistent and replacement-safe for each shareId. UI filters the caller's selections. Repeated shares of one product are distinct records, so room-global dedupe and shared-shortlist policy are unresolved.

sections.title: DECISION FUNNEL
sections.finding: No explicit persistent FINALIST/SELECTED room decisions were found. Likes/votes/shortlist are not purchase intent; define authorized user actions and shared state without inference.

sections.title: DO NOT OVER-AUTOMATE DECISIONS
sections.finding: Current shortlist and votes follow explicit user commands; no automatic selected state or inferred order is introduced.

sections.title: POLLS
sections.finding: Text options with one account-scoped ballot, replacement/withdrawal and close exist. Structured PRODUCT_OPTIONS/IMAGE_OPTIONS and multiple selection are absent.

sections.title: POLL MODEL
sections.finding: Encrypted structured poll records contain creator/question/options/deadline/closure/ballots. No pollType, allowsMultiple or authorized encrypted image/product option schema is implemented.

sections.title: POLL CONSISTENCY
sections.finding: Committed server sequences and verified epoch senders make projection deterministic; one ballot per account is enforced by clients. Server currently validates access/ciphertext/durable send, not encrypted vote semantics. Resolve the literal server-validation requirement without server decryption or trusting client totals.

sections.title: PRODUCT COMPARISON
sections.finding: Compare two to four canonical products using actual typed price/currency/stock/availability/size/color/brand/category fields. Shortlist counts are labeled distinctly; product votes are not inferred from text poll labels.

sections.title: COMPARISON MUST BE DYNAMIC
sections.finding: Current catalog data is hydrated and explicitly missing fields remain unknown/omitted. No inferred material/quality/stock is substituted.

sections.title: DECISION SUMMARY
sections.finding: Product/poll/shortlist counts and comparison exist. A complete shared summary with finalists/selected counts needs the explicit decision model.

sections.title: ASK SELLER — MAJOR FEATURE
sections.finding: Explicit selected-product question uses the canonical encrypted direct flow; no seller admission or automatic room disclosure.

sections.title: STRUCTURED SELLER REQUEST
sections.finding: Immutable correlated request/answer metadata, signed proofs and ciphertext references exist. Full CLOSED/EXPIRED request lifecycle and expiry policy are absent; do not store question plaintext just to copy the suggested model.

sections.title: SELLER PRIVACY BOUNDARY
sections.finding: Seller receives chosen product/question/requester through direct E2EE. No room title/ID/roster/history is disclosed to the seller by the bridge.

sections.title: SELLER RESPONSE CARD
sections.finding: Seller consents to sharing; requester explicitly relays answer into the Room. Canonical accepted message ID, signer, product/question and hashes are verified before structured projection.

sections.title: AVOID DUPLICATE SELLER QUESTIONS
sections.finding: Exact IDs prevent duplicate retries of one request; different members can still create different requests for the same question. Room-level semantic request reuse/suppression is not implemented and must preserve encrypted privacy.

sections.title: INDIVIDUAL PURCHASE
sections.finding: Explicit canonical order-reference sharing and per-viewer authorized hydration preserve private order details. Complete Room Buy/Reserve entry remains open; references do not grant other members buyer/seller access.

sections.title: GROUP ORDER
sections.finding: No shared quantity/variant collection or canonical group-order service was found. Existing Orders tab is not evidence of collective purchasing.

sections.title: GROUP ORDER MODEL
sections.finding: Canonical group-order and participant quantities/variant references plus Order integration are absent. Requires commerce-owned business rules after foundation acceptance; no message-only order/payment truth.

sections.title: GROUP ORDER STATES
sections.finding: DRAFT/COLLECTING/READY/SUBMITTED/etc. are not implemented as a group-order state machine. Adopt only states justified by approved fulfillment/cancellation/payment requirements.

sections.title: VARIANT COLLECTION
sections.finding: No Room group-order variant/quantity collection was found. Future implementation must use actual canonical Product Variant IDs and validated quantities.

sections.title: SHARED BUDGET — OPTIONAL V1/FUTURE
sections.finding: Optional planning-only budget is not implemented. It must never become a wallet balance, payment authorization or escrow truth.

sections.title: ROOM INTELLIGENCE
sections.finding: Real shortlist/poll counts and current price/stock comparisons exist. A distinct lightweight intelligence module for price changes/common favorites/restock/similar options is incomplete.

sections.title: INTELLIGENCE MUST NOT BLOCK ROOM
sections.finding: Optional intelligence is not a prerequisite for chat. Current Room refresh still computes board/catalog work before its final UI refresh; complete dependency-failure/latency isolation is not established.

sections.title: DECISION ASSISTANT — FUTURE AI
sections.finding: Not implemented. Future assistant is optional and must obey reviewed E2EE disclosure/consent policy; no private content sent to AI.

sections.title: AI MUST USE STRUCTURED CONFIRMED CONTEXT
sections.finding: No confirmed-criteria/AI context system exists. If implemented, distinguish MENTIONED/INFERRED/CONFIRMED and keep explicit user decisions authoritative.

sections.title: AI MAY SUMMARIZE ROOM
sections.finding: Catch-me-up AI is future scope. No speculative room summary or server plaintext extraction is introduced.

sections.title: AI IS NEVER REQUIRED FOR CORE ROOM
sections.finding: Current room chat/board/polls/shortlist do not require an AI provider.

sections.title: PRICE DROP ALERT
sections.finding: No canonical price-change-to-room alert workflow with opted scope, event identity, dedupe and frequency controls was found. Historical optional snapshots are not price-change events.

sections.title: LOW STOCK ALERT
sections.finding: Stock display exists; room-specific bounded low-stock notification events are absent. Do not manufacture urgency or notify every member repeatedly.

sections.title: SOLD OUT
sections.finding: Current unavailable/sold-out state does not automatically remove the committed room share. Room-specific Notify on Restock/Find Similar action wiring remains incomplete.

sections.title: RESTOCK
sections.finding: Canonical Demand/restock subscription infrastructure exists outside Rooms. Room opted-in restock event linkage and notifications are not implemented.

sections.title: SIMILAR PRODUCT DISCOVERY
sections.finding: Optional room similarity module is absent. Reuse canonical discovery later; suggestions must not replace existing shortlist or decisions.

sections.title: ROOM REELS / SHORTS
sections.finding: Internal sharing sends canonical structured Reel/Short references; Room chat creates rich cards and reuses WingaRichUi in references-only mode for current authorized hydration/navigation. No multiple-video autoplay is introduced.

sections.title: VOICE IN SHOPPING ROOMS
sections.finding: Canonical Conversations voice/encrypted-media infrastructure exists. Room UI currently offers text/file attachment, not the complete shared voice recorder/player workflow.

sections.title: REACTIONS
sections.finding: Canonical rich message reaction infrastructure exists elsewhere. Room-native reactions/product preference signals are not fully wired; no reaction is promoted to shortlist/selected/order.

sections.title: ROOM SEARCH
sections.finding: Rooms list can be searched by name; this is not private in-room message/product/poll search. The latter remains future scoped, authorized endpoint-side search.

sections.title: ROOM NOTIFICATIONS
sections.finding: Durable generic room push, own mute, dedupe/retries and exact room destination exist. Mention/poll-end/seller/product/group-order categories, per-event preferences and frequency controls remain incomplete.

sections.title: MENTIONS
sections.finding: No canonical Room @mention parser/recipient binding and privacy-safe prioritized notification path was found.

sections.title: MUTE
sections.finding: Canonical account-scoped indefinite mute is implemented with enqueue/dispatch suppression and revision-safe retries. 1-hour/8-hour/week timed expiry and policy-separated critical events are not implemented.

sections.title: LEAVE ROOM
sections.finding: Signed voluntary leave revokes server access immediately, rotates membership through retained admin, supports handoff and preserves history. Product/vote state remains historical; treatment of former-member ballots, shortlist and future group-order obligations needs explicit policy.

sections.title: DELETE / CLOSE ROOM
sections.finding: Per-account archive and terminal final-owner departure exist. Owner close/archive-for-everyone lifecycle and approved erasure/transactional retention policies are absent; own archive must not masquerade as room closure.

sections.title: BLOCKING
sections.finding: Current native room access rejects a blocked pair among active roster owners; it does not silently bypass blocking. This can deny access to otherwise uninvolved members. Explicit shared-room visibility/routing policy and acceptance remain open; voluntary self-leave has separate checks.

sections.title: REPORTING / SAFETY
sections.finding: Canonical explicit-consent report store exists for direct pairs, selected messages/media and reporter authorization. Its current SQL binds creator/recipient pairs; no complete Shopping Room/member/epoch report subject or room UI path is implemented. Reuse Safety after defining exact user-selected disclosure; never add universal decryption.

sections.title: INVITE SECURITY
sections.finding: Only the section heading was supplied. Existing invite controls are audited under 8/9; they do not substitute for missing section 61 wording or any later sections.

resumptionOrder: Resolve Conversations foundation source/security/operational acceptance gaps before new dependent feature development.
Clarify encrypted poll authority, shared shortlist/dedupe, existing-room block/report, creation-before-inviting and lifecycle policies without reducing E2EE.
After acceptance, extend existing share/create and room composer; persist first product with exact retry identity.
Extend existing encrypted decision/poll projections and canonical Safety/notification paths.
Integrate canonical product events and consented Seller-request reuse/lifecycle.
Implement group orders only through commerce-owned variant/order/fulfillment/payment contracts.
Keep optional budget, AI, room search and similarities separately gated.
standingConstraints: No real account/device approval or live message/invite/load activity performed by this audit.
Keep existing deployed Phoenix instance count.
Missing section 61 or later content cannot be inferred from earlier differently numbered specifications.
